company_name.description: Company of the customer. . **Required** in case that billing.firstName & billing.lastName are not provided.

Unique identifier of the company, recognised by the government.

Consumer's email address.

entity_id.description: Entity Id can be located on the organization level as Organization ID (Administration > Organizations > [Organization] > Organisation ID value)
